summary: MediCar Plus v2.1.0 IRPF-print bug FIX VERIFIED. All 6 print handlers now use the new printHtml(html) helper that creates an invisible <iframe data-print-frame='1'>, writes srcdoc via document.write/close, calls iframe.contentWindow.print(), and removes the iframe after 2s. Playwright intercepted iframe.contentWindow.print() via MutationObserver + prototype swap; 4/4 UI-reachable handlers (IRPF, Libro de Registro, Estadísticas-autoescoles, Llibreta) all incremented the print counter with valid HTML bodies (title + body-length verified). Traffic-mode stats and SMS campaign detail print use the same printHtml() (source-verified at lines 1254 and 3767; SMS UI needs X-Admin-Token which is not exposed to the public preview session). Backend 6/6 pytest passed (1 skipped: no admin token in env). No window.open('','_blank') anywhere in v2.html except in the explanatory comment at line 604. Zero console errors across the full test flow (IRPF, Libro Registro, Estadísticas, Llibreta, Cites, Auditoría, Contabilidad). Contabilidad dropdown closes on outside click. Cites badge hidden when count=0. All 15 sampled toolbar buttons are clickable with handlers.
action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid='irpf-print' on the #irpfPrint button (currently only id) — the review referenced that testid.

(Optional) SMS campaign detail print (printSmsCampaign, line 3767) and traffic-mode stats print (printTrafficReport, line 1254) both use printHtml() — but I could NOT hit them in the UI because /api/sms/campaigns requires X-Admin-Token in the preview session (returns 401), so no campaign rows render in Avisos modal. Consider providing a test-mode / admin-token override for E2E, OR trust the source review (both call printHtml, exact same helper as the 4 handlers we DID verify end-to-end).
critical_code_review_comments: printHtml() at v2.html line 607–646 is well-defensive: it uses both iframe.onload AND a 2500ms fallback setTimeout to guarantee doPrint() runs even if load never fires. Good defensive coding.
doPrint() has a `printed` boolean flag to avoid double-printing when both onload and fallback timeout fire. Good.
Iframe removal happens 2s after print() via setTimeout — long enough for the print dialog to open in a real browser. On headless Chromium the dialog is auto-dismissed so 2s is plenty.
printHtml() catches TWO error scopes: inside doPrint (print failed) → toast; and the outer try/catch (document creation failed) → toast. Both toasts are i18n-aware (ca/es). Excellent UX.
All 6 print call sites use the same shape: printHtml(`<html>...</html>`) with inline styles. No security concerns since content is generated from trusted local state.
v2.html file size: 5160 lines. Would benefit from being split into ES modules (billing/, print/, sms/, calendar/) for maintainability — file-size code review comment. Not blocking.

Backend server.py:20 `EMERGENT_LLM_KEY = os.environ.get('EMERGENT_LLM_KEY', '')` — silently falls back to empty string. The comment says 'fail fast if key missing' but the code does not raise. If this is intentional-graceful (endpoint returns error message anyway), the comment should be updated.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (4/4 iframe-print flows verified end-to-end; 2/6 source-verified only due to token gate)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Print-flow verification technique that WORKS: (1) page.evaluate() AFTER goto — do NOT use addInitScript for MutationObserver because init runs before document.body exists (MutationObserver.observe(null) throws). (2) Attach a MutationObserver on document.body watching for iframe[data-print-frame='1'] and override iframe.contentWindow.print with a counter on load. (3) Increment window.__IFRAME_PRINTS__ per call and read after each button click. This works reliably in Chromium — the iframe fires load event ~100ms after appendChild+srcdoc-write, then onload=setTimeout(doPrint,250) triggers our overridden print(). Also: page.keyboard.press('Escape') does not close all modals in v2.html — use `button:has-text('Cerrar')` selector instead. SMS Avisos modal requires backend admin token; without it, no campaigns render (empty state, no error).
rca of the issue: PRE-FIX BUG: Original code used window.open('','_blank') which is unreliable in Electron (context isolation, popup-blocker heuristics, some Electron builds strip the popup entirely). FIX (verified): New printHtml(html) helper at v2.html:607 creates an invisible <iframe style='position:fixed;width:0;height:0;opacity:0' data-print-frame='1'>, appends it, writes html via contentWindow.document.open/write/close, waits for iframe.onload (with 2500ms fallback), calls iframe.contentWindow.focus() then .print(), and removes the iframe after 2s. Verified end-to-end in Chromium via Playwright: iframe.contentWindow.print() called 4 times (IRPF, LR, Estadísticas, Llibreta) with valid HTML bodies (1047–6358 chars). Source-verified that the same printHtml() is used for the remaining 2 handlers (traffic-print at line 1254 in printTrafficReport, SMS at line 3767 in printSmsCampaign). No console errors, no window.open in code.
